descriptions.job-0n44c2u:
OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
 
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. 
 
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
 

About The Opportunity

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own institutional partner products such as Custody, Brokerage, and Fees & Incentive Programs (including MM/MT structures, VIP tiering, and rebate frameworks). Final scope will weigh your background, but the mandate is consistent: build institutional-grade products that compete on infrastructure, economic design, and reliability — and translate that into measurable growth in client adoption, trading volume, and revenue. You will partner with engineering, operations, sales, compliance, and external service providers to ship complex changes that institutional counterparties trust and rely on.

What You’ll Be Doing 

  • Clearly define product direction and roadmaps for Custody OES, drive its evolution and turn client and partner requirements into shipped features. Grow the client and partner base. Optimize operations through self-service portals and process automation.
  • Own the fee schedule and incentive programs (MM/MT, VIP tiers, rebates), balancing market dynamics, competitor moves, and institutional needs against company strategy, revenue, and competitive position. Build and continuously evolve AI agents for competitor intel, liquidity analysis, fee and rebate simulation, and program operations.
  • Own the commercial logic of your product lines. Build ROI-grounded business cases for product and partnership investments; quantify revenue and AUM impact to drive prioritisation;
  • Articulate strategy, progress, and trade-offs to internal leadership and external institutional clients.
  • Partner cross-functionally with engineering, design, compliance, and legal to ship complex changes. Navigate multi-jurisdictional regulatory constraints (HK, SG, EU, US) and balance trade-offs between speed, scalability, and compliance.

What We Look For In You 

  • PM experience at a crypto exchange on Custody OES, or at a custody, or background from traditional finance on Collateral / Tri-party / CCP solutions. Deep market knowledge and an end-to-end grasp of how counterparties, custody, execution, and settlement connect.
  • Solid understanding of liquidity dynamics and how institutional crypto markets actually work. Prior hands-on experience managing fee schedules or designing incentive programs (MM/MT, VIP tiers, rebates) is a strong plus.
  • Proven experience of leading strategic business reviews, facilitating on-site requirement discovery, and converting client feedback into prioritized product initiatives. Strong track record of partnering with Sales, BD, and Relationship Management teams in a B2B institutional setting.
  • Proven ability to bring structure and clarity to complex problems, align senior stakeholders across functions, and drive decisions and execution. Able to communicate complex strategies and trade-offs with clarity and influence, producing high-quality strategy documents, product plans, roadmaps, and executive-level presentations. Demonstrated effectiveness leading and influencing globally distributed teams across time zones and diverse cultural contexts.
  • Hands-on experience leveraging AI tools for market research and product operations. Building automated workflows, using AI for data analysis, or prototyping AI-powered features.
  • Candidates with more experience will be considered as Product Director (P7-1). Experience building a zero-to-one product is a strong plus.

Perks & Benefits 

  • Competitive total compensation package
  • L&D programs and education subsidy for employees' growth and development
  • Various team building programs and company events
  • Wellness and meal allowances
  • Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
  • More that we love to tell you along the process!

descriptions.job-1u86q7a:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe, LLC. is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

What you’ll do

Responsibilities

  • Develop scalable computer systems that manage a large volume of information and use them to fulfill business goals for the company and its partners.
  • Improve backend scalability and performance by integrating lightweight backend framework, overhauling APIs and optimizing database systems.
  • Design and build tools that ingest and process signals from various sources to make them more accessible for the company’s partner teams. 
  • Design and implement logging and data visualization system for backend APIs.
  • Diagnose and resolve software issues reported from production, automated testing, QA testing and customers.
  • Design and implement scalable and reliable automated testing suites to reduce manual Quality Assurance tasks.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams and streamlined software development and deployment processes with Continuous Integration (CI) and Continuous Delivery (CD) pipelines.

Who you are

Minimum requirements

Must have a Master's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, plus six (6) years of software development experience.

Must also have four (4) years of experience in each of the following:

  • Building software solutions in Java, C++, Python, or Ruby;
  • Designing, building and maintaining scalable systems;
  • Translating business needs into software requirements and designs;
  • Debugging production issues across services and multiple levels of the stack;
  • Distributed systems; and
  • Design and implementation of scalable high-performance RESTful microservices.

Salary: $206,086 - $285,600/yr

This salary range represents the base salary range for the role and any sales commissions / sales bonuses targets, if applicable, would be in addition to the base salary.

40 hrs/week

50% Telecommuting permitted.

Multiple Positions Available. 

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends. WA58
descriptions.job-1old8iu:
Chainalysis is hiring a Senior Manager, Talent Management & Organizational Development to own the programs, processes, and resources that drive talent quality across the company. You will report to the VP of People.

This is a high-impact IC role. Some foundations are already in place. A performance review cycle runs today, and your job is to assess it, sharpen it, and raise the bar on how ratings, calibration, and reviews work in practice. Other programs, to support top talent development do not exist and this role has an opportunity to create lasting programs from scratch. In both cases, you will present recommendations to the People Leadership Team, get alignment on direction, and then execute.

A core part of this role is making other people effective. You will create the playbooks, toolkits, and training that HR Business Partners and people managers at every level need to run great talent processes without heavy central support. You build the content. You run delivery. You measure whether it lands.

The right person brings strong practices from a consulting background or a large, well-structured organization, but does not try to copy-paste them. Chainalysis is a growth-stage company where priorities shift, ambiguity is normal, and the ability to adapt matters more than a perfect framework. You work iteratively, move fast, and stay grounded in data.

In this role, you’ll:

  • Evaluate and improve the existing performance review cycle, including goal setting, mid-year check-ins, annual reviews, ratings, and calibration.

  • Build the supporting materials (manager guides, calibration toolkits, talking points, FAQs) that make the process work at all levels.

  • Partner with People Analytics to track completion rates, rating distributions, and other indicators of process health. Use data to drive cycle-over-cycle improvement.

  • Partner with HRBPs and business leaders to ensure that the organization has a high talent delivery model.

  • Build the succession planning program for critical roles: readiness assessments, development plans, and pipeline visibility for leadership, including designing and running the organization’s talent mapping process, assessment methodology (9-box or equivalent), criteria, and cadence.

  • Create the frameworks that make talent conversations consistent, data-informed, and actionable across business units.

  • Identify frameworks to address retention risks for high-impact contributors and recommend targeted interventions. Work with HRBPs and business leaders to roll out and integrate into ongoing talent conversations.

  • Develop the content library that HRBPs need to operate as strategic talent advisors: playbooks, templates, facilitation guides, and one-pagers.

  • Create enablement resources for people managers at all levels: how to set goals, give feedback, run development conversations, assess talent, and navigate the review cycle.

  • Run train-the-trainer sessions, workshops, and office hours to build capability across HRBPs and managers.

  • Translate talent strategy into practical tools people can use independently.

  • Pick up L&D programming where it connects to talent and performance outcomes: leadership development, manager effectiveness, and high-potential acceleration.

  • Identify capability gaps through performance data, engagement results, and business priorities. Recommend targeted interventions.

  • Partner with external vendors and internal subject matter experts to curate or build development content where gaps exist.

  • Advise on team effectiveness, organizational design, and change management as the company scales.

  • Bring an OD lens to talent programs to make sure they reinforce the culture and operating model Chainalysis is building.

  • Bring data, options, and clear recommendations to the People Leadership Team for key decisions on talent philosophy, program design, and process changes.

  • Facilitate discussions that lead to aligned decisions. Then own the execution.

  • Keep PLT informed on program outcomes, risks, and what is and is not working.

We’re looking for candidates who have:

  • 5-8 years in talent management and organizational development with meaningful time spent building or redesigning talent programs (not only administering existing ones). You may have led or been part of an L&D organization, but if you are principally a training designer or facilitator, this role will not be a fit.

  • Critical thinking: you review, assess, and define based on first principles. You are curiosity-led and self-directed, anticipating the organization’s needs versus waiting to have them defined for you.

  • Building with agility: you are comfortable with ambiguity. You can take a vague problem, structure it, propose a path forward, and ship something useful before you have every answer. You work iteratively. You ship a minimum viable version, gather feedback, and improve. When priorities shift, you adjust without losing momentum.

  • Enablement driven: you think about adoption, not just design. You have a track record in adult-learning and programs that flex to the audience. When you build something, you build the training, the resources, and the feedback loop that make it relevant and sticky.

  • Metrics orientation: you default to measuring outcomes. You are comfortable with people analytics, dashboards, and making a case with data. You create with data and AI as tools, not the other way around.

  • Communication: clear, direct communicator. You can present options to a leadership team, facilitate a calibration session, and write a one-page toolkit with equal skill.

  • Workday fluency: experience working in Workday for talent and performance processes.

Nice to have experience:

  • Background in human capital management consulting (EY, Deloitte, or comparable) and/or OD design at talent dense organizations who have scaled.

  • Experience at a technology company during a period of rapid growth or organizational change.

  • Coaching certification, OD certification, or advanced degree in I/O Psychology, Organizational Development, or a related field.

  • Familiarity with succession planning, including talent assessment, career pathing frameworks, and competency models (e.g. 9-box).

  • Track record of using AI-enabled authoring tools in enablement and curriculum development.

AI at Chainalysis
AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.

About Chainalysis

Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.

You belong here. 

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. If you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here. We can’t wait to meet you.
descriptions.job-145bmna:
Better Money

Strike is the Bitcoin company. With Strike, you can buy and sell bitcoin, pay bills, and borrow against your holdings. From individuals to businesses, Strike is purpose-built for every step of the Bitcoin journey. Available in more than 100 countries — including the U.S., Europe, Latin America, and Africa — Strike is building a better financial system powered by Bitcoin. Bitcoin is better money. Strike is how you use it.

Role

Strike has built one of the leading brands in Bitcoin, a global customer base, and a large organic audience without building a traditional marketing organization.

Now we are looking for a senior marketing leader to build that organization from the ground up.

As Head of Marketing, you will determine how Strike goes to market, how we acquire and retain customers, how we bring new products to market, how we measure marketing performance, and what team, systems, agencies, and capabilities we need to build over time.

You will own marketing strategy, customer acquisition, lifecycle marketing, product marketing, go-to-market strategy, attribution, marketing operations, budget, and team development.

This is a builder role. You will not inherit a mature marketing organization. You will build one.

You should be comfortable moving between strategy and execution: defining the plan, building the infrastructure, launching the first programs, determining what works, and then hiring a team around the capabilities that deserve to scale.

Strike already has a strong brand, voice, and organic distribution. It is about building the marketing capabilities that amplify them, translate them into customer growth, and extend them across products and markets.

You will work closely with Product, Data, Finance, Brand, and Communications and report directly to the CEO.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and own Strike's global marketing strategy, priorities, operating plan, and budget.
  • Build the marketing organization from the ground up, including its people, processes, technology, measurement systems, agencies, and operating cadence.
  • Develop a deep understanding of Strike's customers, segments, behaviors, and motivations, and use those insights to shape positioning, acquisition strategy, product adoption, and marketing investment.
  • Own go-to-market strategy for major product launches, new markets, and strategic initiatives.
  • Build product marketing capabilities that clearly communicate who Strike's products are for, why they matter, and how they should be positioned in the market.
  • Build a scalable customer acquisition engine across paid search, app stores, affiliates, creators, partnerships, sponsorships, referrals, and other channels.
  • Identify and develop new acquisition channels rather than relying exclusively on established performance marketing playbooks.
  • Establish clear channel economics, including customer acquisition cost, lifetime value, payback periods, cohort performance, incrementality, and return on marketing investment.
  • Build Strike's marketing attribution, analytics, and measurement infrastructure in partnership with Data and Engineering.
  • Own lifecycle marketing across onboarding, activation, engagement, product adoption, cross-sell, reactivation, and retention.
  • Develop programs that increase adoption of Strike products among existing customers.
  • Turn Strike's existing audience, brand, content, and organic distribution into measurable customer acquisition and revenue channels.
  • Build and optimize referral, affiliate, creator, and partner marketing programs.
  • Determine the appropriate mix of internal capabilities, agencies, technology, and external partners.
  • Hire, lead, and develop the marketing team as the function grows.
  • Partner closely with Brand and Communications to ensure that growth strengthens Strike's brand and maintains the trust we have built with customers.

We are not looking to manufacture vanity metrics or pursue growth at any cost. Strike's marketing organization should compound trust, attract high-quality customers, and build durable, economically rational growth.

What Success Looks Like

Over your first 12–18 months:

  • Strike has a clear marketing strategy, operating plan, budget, and company-wide marketing cadence.
  • We have a strong understanding of our customers and the segments where Strike has the greatest opportunity to win.
  • Major product launches and strategic initiatives have disciplined go-to-market strategies.
  • We understand CAC, LTV, payback, incrementality, cohort performance, and channel economics well enough to allocate capital with confidence.
  • Strike has developed multiple repeatable and scalable customer acquisition channels.
  • Lifecycle marketing materially improves onboarding, activation, product adoption, retention, and customer value.
  • Strike's existing brand and organic audience translate more systematically into customer growth and revenue.
  • The company has built the marketing infrastructure, systems, and measurement capabilities required to scale.
  • A high-performing marketing team has been built around the channels and capabilities that prove they work.

What We're Looking For

  • Significant experience leading growth or marketing at a scaled consumer technology, fintech, financial services, or similarly complex business.
  • Experience building or materially transforming a marketing function rather than simply inheriting and operating an established organization.
  • A true builder mentality. You should be comfortable personally doing work before you have a team to delegate it to.
  • Demonstrated success building, testing, and scaling customer acquisition channels.
  • Strong command of marketing economics, including CAC, LTV, payback periods, cohort analysis, attribution, incrementality, and return on investment.
  • Experience implementing marketing attribution, analytics, and measurement infrastructure.
  • Experience managing meaningful marketing budgets and allocating spend based on performance.
  • Strong understanding of lifecycle marketing and conversion across the customer funnel.
  • Strong product marketing and go-to-market instincts, including customer segmentation, positioning, messaging, and product launches.
  • Experience with partnerships, creators, affiliates, referral programs, or other nontraditional acquisition channels.
  • Experience marketing high-consideration or high-value products where trust and customer quality matter as much as acquisition volume.
  • Strong appreciation for brand and the judgment to know when marketing should amplify an existing brand rather than reinvent it.
  • Proven ability to recruit, manage, and develop high-performing teams.
  • Strong cross-functional operator who can work effectively with Product, Data, Finance, Brand, Communications, and executive leadership.
  • Comfortable operating with ambiguity, making decisions with incomplete information, and building systems where none previously existed.
  • Genuine interest in Bitcoin and a strong understanding of Strike's Bitcoin-only positioning.

US - Based Positions

  • Salary range: $246K - $273K
  • Equity in a high-growth startup
  • Cell phone and internet reimbursement
  • Flexible PTO, sick leave, and parental leave
  • No trading fees when you buy and sell bitcoin on Strike

Other Locations

  • Location-dependent competitive salary
  • No trading fees when you buy and sell bitcoin on Strike
  • Other benefits are location dependent

We do not make hiring decisions based on educational history whatsoever. Our Founder is a college dropout. We employ high school dropouts, PHD candidates and everything in-between. We do not hire credentials. We simply hire talented, passionate individuals who are excited to be a part of our team.

By clicking submit application below, you consent to our use and processing of your data as described in our Candidate Privacy Notice.

Use of AI. Strike uses AI-assisted tools to help review, assess, and verify applications and support the integrity of our recruitment process. A human is always involved in our hiring decisions — we do not rely on automated processing alone.
descriptions.job-1e8mtpi:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.


Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Performance marketing at Kraken is being rebuilt from the ground up. Manual bid management, creative iteration, budget allocation, and audience targeting are being replaced by agent systems that detect signals, make decisions, and execute continuously, learning from every result.

As Sr. Performance Marketing Manager, Growth Systems, you bring deep paid growth expertise and apply it to the systems replacing manual execution. Your job is to define the logic: what signals matter, what decisions should be automated, what guardrails must exist, and what the creative feedback loop looks like across paid channels. The engineers build what you spec. The agents run what you design.

While your primary focus is performance and paid growth, you will also contribute to automating other growth levers, including CRO, incentives, referrals, and cross-channel workflows, as the engine expands. The domain expertise is your anchor. The systems thinking is what scales it.

This role is for someone who has run growth at scale and found themselves constantly asking why are we doing this manually. If you've felt the ceiling of what human-operated paid growth can achieve and want to build the system that breaks through it, this is that role.

 

The opportunity

  • Refine creative and copy variants generated by the AI creative layer, applying domain judgment to what will perform before the data confirms it

  • QA agent outputs, review what the system produces, identify where it falls short, and define the corrections that improve it

  • Monitor workflow performance and continuously improve, this system compounds with your input, it does not run itself

  • Define and spec automation workflows for paid growth, from creative fatigue detection to budget reallocation to geo level channel mix optimization to audience signal processing

  • Work directly with the build team to translate your workflow specs into working agent automations

  • Define knowledge base inputs for the paid growth agents, what rules, guardrails, and campaign logic should be codified and kept current

  • Extend your systems thinking to other growth levers, CRO, incentives, referrals, and lifecycle, as the engine expands across growth functions

 

What you bring

  • 8+ years in performance or paid growth, you have run campaigns at scale across major paid channels and understand the mechanics deeply

  • Deep expertise across core paid channels (Meta, Google/YouTube, TikTok, Apple Search Ads, programmatic/DSPs) rather than just "major paid channels" generically

  • Comfort with data, you can read a performance dashboard, interpret signal from noise, and define what an agent should optimize for

  • Strong written communication, the workflow specs you write become the blueprints engineers build from. Clarity matters.

  • Systems thinking, you can map a growth workflow as a series of triggers, decisions, actions, and measurements. You think in logic, not just tactics

  • Prompt engineering curiosity, you don't need to be an engineer, but you are willing to learn how to communicate with AI systems precisely and improve their outputs

  • High agency, you define the work, you don't wait for it to be defined for you

 

Nice to haves

  • Experience with marketing automation, CRM, or lifecycle messaging systems

  • Exposure to A/B testing and experimentation frameworks

  • Background in fintech, consumer financial products, or regulated industries

  • Any hands-on experience with workflow automation or no-code orchestration tools

 
 

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

Stay connected

Follow us on Twitter

Learn on the Kraken Blog

Connect on LinkedIn

descriptions.job-1uk444m:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. 

The Cashiering team’s mission is to ensure accurate, timely movement of funds across customer brokerage and retirement accounts while delivering a compliant, high-quality client experience. We operate with ethics and precision at the center of everything we do to protect our customers' assets. Our team works closely with partners in Compliance, Operations, and Technology to streamline cashiering processes. We foster a supportive, collaborative environment where team members work together to solve complex operational challenges! Our collective goal is to build trusted, scalable financial processes that support Robinhood's growth.

As a Cashiering Specialist, you will manage high-volume cashiering workflows—primarily reviewing check deposits, but also ACH, wire, and other brokerage transactions—serving as a key operational link between advisors, clients, custodians, and internal partners. In this position, you will execute transactions with high accuracy and efficiency while adhering to strict regulatory requirements. You will collaborate daily with advisors and internal operations teams to resolve inquiries and transaction discrepancies. Your work directly impacts the customer experience by ensuring that fund movements are completed seamlessly. This role provides an excellent opportunity to expand your knowledge of financial markets and back-office operations!

This role is based in our Clearwater, FL office(s), with in-person attendance expected 5 days per week during the 6-month onboarding period. After onboarding, in-person attendance is expected at least 3 days a week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. 

What you’ll do

  • Process a high volume of check deposits efficiently, and in line with internal policies and regulatory requirements.
  • Monitor and manage daily transaction queues to meet strict deadlines and service-level expectations, researching and resolving discrepancies and inquiries from initial intake to final resolution.
  • Serve as a primary contact for advisors, their staff, and clients across phone, email, and internal systems, providing clear updates and a seamless, professional experience.
  • Partner with our clearing firm and internal teams (Operations, Compliance, Technology, Advisor Services) to facilitate transactions, resolve issues, and support collaborative projects across these departments.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and client experience within cashiering operations.

What you bring

  • Strong knowledge of cashiering procedures, workflows, and regulatory considerations, along with a basic understanding of financial markets and the securities industry.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Abuse Operations is the front-line incident response and remediation function handling active product abuse and fraud impacting Stripe and its merchants. This multi-disciplinary group, spanning Incident Managers, Investigators, Forward Deployed Security Engineers, and Data Scientists, neutralizes active attacks, gathers requirements for operational tooling, and leads incidents. The team  works directly with impacted merchants to resolve technical incidents and policy abuse rapidly. Operating primarily across Eastern, Pacific and Western European time zones, these team members regularly coordinate with global stakeholders across the world.

What you’ll do

You'll play a critical role in safeguarding our financial ecosystem by investigating high-risk accounts and identifying complex patterns of fraud during incidents. You will lead incident response for product abuse and fraud events, conducting deep-dive analyses to identify root causes. By collaborating cross-functionally, you will drive improvements that enhance our fraud detection and prevention strategies at scale. Your expertise will be essential in automating response processes through agentic approaches, allowing us to safeguard merchants and neutralize threats with speed and precision.

Responsibilities

  • Investigate, mitigate, and remediate urgent fraud incidents (e.g., ATO, card testing), utilizing FT3-mapped detection and signals enrichment to reduce uncertainty and accelerate response.
  • As part of incidents, analyze high-risk accounts to identify fraudulent merchants, card testing, account takeovers, and other fraud vectors, classifying them using FT3 (Fraud Taxonomy 3.0) to standardize threat intelligence.
  • Lead incident root cause analyses to identify gaps in current systems and strategies, leveraging the FT3 framework, data-driven model to drive enhancements and process improvements for emerging fraud risks.
  • Streamline incident response capabilities, ensuring the tooling and processes are clear, accurate and efficient
  • Work cross-functionally with security, fraud and data science teams to build agentic solutions for responding to abuse incidents at scale
  • Effectively communicate cross-functionally with legal and policy teams to assess and mitigate risks, while demonstrating strong problem-solving under pressure.
  • Collaborate effectively with teammates, leading projects, mentoring others, and developing and championing quality standards within the team

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 10+ years of experience conducting incident response in security, product abuse or trust domains
  • 10+ years experience analyzing large data sets to solve problems and/or building models with a behavioral approach to fraud detection
  • B.S. or M.S. Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience
  • Expert knowledge of Python and SQL, and familiarity with other programming languages
  • Existing experience with log analysis (e.g. first or third party applications, system / data access, event logs), network security, digital forensics, and incident response investigations
  • Ability to communicate results clearly and focus on impact
  • Ability to think creatively and holistically about reducing risk in a complex environment

Preferred qualifications

  • An adversarial mindset, understanding the goals, behaviors, and TTPs of threat actors.
  • Experience with engineering, data processing and analysis tools (e.g. Databricks, Trino, etc.)
  • Familiarity with common open-source frameworks for big data processing and/or data science (PySpark, Pandas, Sci-kit Learn, etc.)
  • Experience with tactical threat intelligence and/or hunting for sophisticated threat actors in an enterprise environment
  • Ability to proactively challenge the status quo by leveraging data and taking a user-centric approach to address complex product integrity challenges

About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

Ramp is in a critical phase of growth. We grew immensely last year and are building out a talented business systems team to ensure we maintain this trajectory for years to come. You’ll work directly with our Sales, Account Management, Partnerships, and Product teams to execute mission-critical business systems projects across the organization. This is a key role where you will be uniquely positioned to impact the full picture of Ramp’s growth efforts through systems development.


What You’ll Do

  • Own top of funnel GTM systems: the roadmap, the architecture decisions inside them, and their operational health

  • Run HubSpot as a system rather than a tool: workflows, lists, forms, properties, lifecycle stages, campaign structure, and the permissions and naming conventions that keep it from sprawling

  • Keep HubSpot and Salesforce in agreement and the lists built off them clean: field mappings, inclusion lists, sync error triage and dedupe rules, then the ICP segmentation, suppression logic, enrichment, and email validation that stand between a Growth list and a send

  • Build and deploy the Salesforce automation behind it: record-triggered and screen flows, validation rules, custom objects and fields, permission sets, and approvals

  • Own the path from form fill to booked meeting: capture, enrichment, dedupe, routing, sequence enrollment, and speed to lead, and hold the operational health of every hop in that chain

  • Prioritize incoming requests against ROI. Make the call on what gets built, what gets deferred, and what gets declined, and show the numbers behind it

  • Drive cross-functional alignment on scope, sequencing, and tradeoffs and carry it through to closure without a manager in the room

What You’ll Need

  • 5+ years in business systems, marketing operations, or revenue operations at a fast-paced company

  • Deep hands-on HubSpot experience: workflows built and debugged, list, form, and property architecture you designed rather than inherited, and a clear view of how an instance degrades when nobody governs it

  • Salesforce Admin certification or equivalent hands-on experience, including non-trivial flows built and debugged when they broke, and a clear view of why declarative automation goes wrong at scale

  • Funnel definitions owned in practice: lead source, campaign membership, UTM capture, and the MQL to SQL handoff, with attribution reporting the business actually trusts

  • A habit of framing problems rather than waiting for a spec: ambiguous requests taken on, decided, and shipped

  • You get in the weeds and build: elegant and scalable solutions, with AI leaned on to automate the work wherever it holds up

  • You dissect a problem, drive it to completion with little supervision, and can explain the tradeoffs to any audience



Nice to Have

  • Marketing systems depth beyond the CRM: paid media and ad platform integrations, lifecycle email programs, landing page and form tooling, plus deliverability and list hygiene at sending volume

  • A product mindset toward internal tooling: treating stakeholders as users, shipping in phases and measuring adoption after launch

We're looking for forward-thinking individuals who share our passion for making AI universally accessible, secure, and affordable. Join us in building a platform that empowers innovators everywhere to turn their visionary AI projects into reality.

About the Role

When a customer's GPU cluster has a problem, you are the first engineer they talk to, and most of the time you are the only one they need to. You own the ticket from the first response to the resolution, you own the clock against our SLA, and you keep ownership even when the problem needs deeper help.

This is not a ticket routing job. You will be in Linux every day, on real infrastructure, fixing real customer problems. The people who do this well here move into the Forward Deployed Engineer role, and we will build that path with you deliberately.

Who You Are

  • Ticket ownership, end to end. You own every ticket you pick up, including after it escalates. You do not hand off, you pull in the engineer you need and stay on it until the customer is working.

  • The SLA clock. First response, severity classification, and keeping us honest against our response commitments. You are the person who knows where every open issue stands.

  • First technical response and triage. Reproduce the problem, gather the logs and configuration that matter, and make the first call on whether the fault is ours or the provider's.

  • Customer environment access and configuration. SSH key and access issues, NFS mounts and storage, quotas, security groups, container and driver questions, billing and account questions.

  • Runbook execution and authoring. Run the documented play when there is one. When you solve something new, write the runbook so the next person does not escalate it.

  • Documentation. Keep our customer-facing docs and internal knowledge base current. Most repeat tickets are a documentation gap.

  • Very strong Linux experience and daily work in the CLI.

  • Experience owning tickets against a response SLA in cloud, hosting, or infrastructure support.

  • Solid networking and storage fundamentals: SSH, NFS and mounts, DNS, firewalls and security groups.

  • Working familiarity with GPU workloads: nvidia-smi, drivers, CUDA, containers.

  • Clear and fast written communication under time pressure. Customers read what you write while they are blocked.

  • Good judgment about the limits of your own knowledge, and a bias toward escalating early with a complete picture rather than late with a guess.

  • Comfortable working across time zones and with an on-call rotation for critical issues.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with ticketing and on-call tooling (Zendesk, Linear, PagerDuty, or similar).

  • Scripting in bash or Python to automate repeat work.

  • Exposure to Slurm, Kubernetes, or Docker in a multi-tenant environment.

  • Background in GPU cloud, HPC, or a hardware-adjacent support org.

descriptions.job-1fzsrja:
Block is one company built from many blocks, all united by the same purpose of economic empowerment. The blocks that form our foundational teams — People, Finance, Counsel, Hardware, Information Security, Platform Infrastructure Engineering, and more — provide support and guidance at the corporate level. They work across business groups and around the globe, spanning time zones and disciplines to develop inclusive People policies, forecast finances, give legal counsel, safeguard systems, nurture new initiatives, and more. Every challenge creates possibilities, and we need different perspectives to see them all. Bring yours to Block.

The Role

We're looking for a cross-disciplinary builder to own how our people data ecosystem comes together — from raw pipelines to predictive models to the agentic workflows that put insight into action. This is not a traditional People Analyst role. You won't just answer questions with dashboards; you'll design and build the end-to-end system that makes People data trustworthy, intelligent, and increasingly autonomous.

This is a senior individual contributor role. You'll lead through technical depth and craft rather than headcount — designing architecture, writing production code, and setting the technical bar for how People data and AI work at our company.

You'll operate at the intersection of data engineering, data science, people analytics, and agentic AI — fluent enough in each to see how the whole system connects, and hands-on enough to build the connective tissue yourself.

You Will

  • Design, build, and maintain reliable data pipelines that unify people data across HRIS, ATS, performance, compensation, and engagement systems.
  • Model data for analytics and ML use, with a focus on quality, lineage, privacy, and governance of sensitive workforce data.
  • Build predictive and diagnostic models (attrition, hiring funnel health, org network analysis, compensation equity, workforce planning).
  • Translate ambiguous people questions into rigorous, defensible analyses — and translate results back into decisions leaders can act on.
  • Partner on our semi-annual employee engagement survey — from instrument design and data collection to analysis, driver identification, and turning results into actionable insight for leaders.
  • Design and deploy AI agents and automations that operationalize insight: monitoring signals, generating reports, drafting recommendations, and triggering workflows without manual effort.
  • Establish the guardrails, evaluation, and human-in-the-loop patterns that make agentic systems safe and trustworthy on sensitive data.
  • Own the architecture that ties pipelines, models, and agents into one coherent system — and continuously evolve it as tools and needs change.
  • Set the technical direction and standards for People data and AI, and raise the bar through code review, design docs, and mentorship of peers (leading by influence, not by managing a team).
  • Partner with People, Data Platform, Security, and Legal to ensure the system is compliant, scalable, and genuinely useful.

You Have

  • 8+ years of relevant experience
  • Proven experience building data pipelines (SQL, Python, dbt/Airflow or similar, cloud data warehouses).
  • Solid data science foundation — statistics, ML, experiment design, and the judgment to know when a simple model beats a complex one.
  • Working knowledge of people/HR data and the sensitivity, ethics, and nuance it demands.
  • Hands-on experience with LLMs and agentic frameworks — building automations, prompts, tool-use, and evaluation loops.
  • Strong systems thinking: you see how components connect and design for the whole, not just the part in front of you.
  • Excellent communication — you can explain a model to an executive and a workflow to an engineer

Even Better

  • Experience with people analytics platforms (Workday, Visier, etc.).
  • Background in organizational network analysis or workforce planning.
  • Experience deploying AI in regulated or privacy-sensitive environments.

Why This Role is Difference

Most companies split this work across three or four people who rarely talk to each other — an engineer who builds pipes, an analyst who makes charts, and a data scientist who ships models into a void. You'll own the whole system, and use agentic AI to make it more than the sum of its parts. This is a role for a senior builder who wants deep technical ownership and impact without stepping off the tools to manage a team. If you're energized by building intelligent systems on top of the most human data a company has, this is for you.

Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at circle.com.

What you’ll be part of:

Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. What you'll be responsible for:

Circle is seeking a hands-on and technically sharp Senior Security Engineer, Executive & Endpoint Security to contribute to Circle’s security program while serving as the primary on-site technical network and endpoint security resource for our most sensitive users and locations, including remote offices and other key company sites.

This role has two important pillars. First, and as the primary focus, you will support Circle’s senior leaders and remote locations by implementing and maintaining tailored security controls and capabilities for our most sensitive users and environments. This includes hands-on support for security needs that require a trusted local presence and close partnership with Physical Security.

Second, as a member of Security Operations, you will support Circle’s endpoint and network security programs across our operational environments and key company sites. You will work alongside Security Operations engineers to implement, maintain, and troubleshoot endpoint, network, and infrastructure security controls, with an emphasis on capabilities requiring hands-on, on-site support.

You are comfortable operating across both worlds, from supporting senior leaders and sensitive locations to engineering and maintaining technical security controls across Circle’s endpoint and network environments. If you take pride in precise execution, high-trust relationships, and hands-on work with a direct, tangible impact on the security of a global financial company, we would love to hear from you.


What you'll work on:

  • Serve as the primary on-site security resource for Circle’s senior leaders and remote locations, deploying, configuring, and validating tailored security controls with professionalism and discretion.

  • Configure and support endpoints, mobile devices, and related technology for senior leaders, ensuring security controls and approved configuration standards are implemented, validated, and maintained throughout the device lifecycle.

  • As a member of Security Operations, support Circle’s endpoint and network security programs across operational environments and key company sites, including the implementation, validation, troubleshooting, and maintenance of endpoint, network, and infrastructure security controls.

  • Perform on-site security assessments at key company locations, identify control gaps, and execute remediation activities in coordination with leadership and stakeholders.

  • Partner with Physical Security and other stakeholders at company locations to ensure endpoint, network, and infrastructure security controls complement physical security protections and site requirements.

  • Act as a trusted, in-person security contact for senior leaders and other key stakeholders, delivering a high-touch experience in sensitive and high-visibility settings.

  • Develop and maintain rigorous documentation, runbooks, deployment procedures, and configuration standards for on-site implementations, assessments, and control validation to support repeatable execution, operational continuity, and audit readiness.

  • Collaborate with IT, Physical Security, Compliance, Engineering, and other cross-functional teams to ensure security implementations align with company standards, operational requirements, and regulatory obligations.

  • Provide support for after-hours technical issue response and urgent operational escalation.

  • Travel as needed to support senior leaders, remote locations, operational environments, and key company sites.

     

What you'll bring to Circle:

  • 4+ years of experience in security engineering or IT security operations, with meaningful hands-on experience across endpoint, mobile, and network security.

  • Willingness and ability to travel regularly, domestically and internationally, to Circle office locations, residences, and secure custody environments; this is a core requirement of the role, not an occasional ask.

  • Comfort and professionalism operating in executive and VIP environments. You are discreet, personable, and capable of delivering technical work seamlessly in high-visibility, high-sensitivity settings.

  • Hands-on proficiency with endpoint, mobile, and network security technologies, including day-to-day security operations as well as the provisioning, configuration, troubleshooting, and validation of devices and controls for individual high-trust users and environments.

  • Strong attention to detail and a methodical approach to on-site configuration, documentation, and control validation; you do not cut corners in high-trust environments.

  • Familiarity with physical-logical security boundaries and the ability to coordinate effectively with Physical Security teams on shared control surfaces at office and key locations.

  • Solid understanding of zero-trust principles and how they apply to endpoint, mobile, network, and user environment security.

  • Ability to work independently in the field, exercise sound judgment without constant supervision, and escalate appropriately when something doesn't look right.

  • Strong communication skills, able to explain technical security requirements clearly to non-technical executive stakeholders and document work precisely for audit purposes.

  • Experience working in financial services, digital asset management, or financial technology is strongly desired.

  • Experience supporting security within office, co-location, or other sensitive operational environments, including site security assessments and the integration of technical and physical security controls.

  • Proven experience managing multiple vendor relationships, contract administration, and partner coordination.

Proposal Writer / Capture & Growth Manager

Growth / Business Development · Remote (U.S.), Washington, DC or San Francisco preferred · Full time

About Us

Swan delivers the future of defense and industry through scalable autonomous products. Swan is backed by leading defense VCs including a16z’s American Dynamism fund.

Role Overview

Swan is seeking a Proposal Writer / Growth Operations Manager to sit at the heart of our growth engine. In this role you are, first and foremost, a writer. You will craft the compelling technical narratives and documents that win new business, while also owning the capture process that shapes and qualifies the opportunities behind them. You will partner across business development, engineering, program management, finance, legal, and the executive team to translate Swan’s autonomy and hardware capabilities into mission-focused proposals that close deals. This is a build-it role. You will create structure where none exists, run the proposal operation end to end, keep the pipeline and internal initiatives moving, and navigate the fast-paced, high-stakes environment of a hyper-growth defense-technology startup. You thrive on short timelines, understand the U.S. Government acquisition process, and know how to move an opportunity from first contact to signed contract. This position supports DoD, OTA, SBIR/STTR, DIU, and other federal technology pursuits.

Key Responsibilities

Proposal Writing and Technical Content

  • Serve as primary author for technical and management proposal volumes, including technical and management approaches, past performance narratives, staffing approaches, Quality Management Plans, Risk Management Plans, Statements of Work, CDRLs, and supporting technical documentation.
  • Produce supporting artifacts including white papers, quad charts, one-pagers, and capability statements.
  • Translate complex engineering concepts into clear, persuasive, evaluator-focused proposal language, working closely with Swan’s engineering team to accurately represent our technology to customers.
  • Maintain consistency in terminology, voice, and tone across every volume and pursuit.
  • Refine drafts to improve clarity, flow, and persuasiveness, and support other authors through review cycles.
  • Build and curate a reusable content library of past performance, technical boilerplate, briefs, and graphics for use across the business.

Proposal Management and Process

  • Own end-to-end proposal development, leading responses to Government and customer RFPs, RFIs, RFQs, white papers, SBIR/STTR, and OTA solicitations from kickoff through submission.
  • Develop compliance matrices, build proposal schedules, track writing assignments, coordinate SMEs, manage action items, and maintain document versions.
  • Run color team reviews (pink, red, gold), incorporate executive feedback, and prepare final production packages.
  • Continuously improve the proposal process to ensure on-time, fully compliant, high-quality submissions across multiple concurrent pursuits.
  • Manage proposal content on unclassified and, as needed, classified systems, ensuring security compliance and proper marking and handling throughout.

Capture and Pipeline

  • Drive capture management for priority pursuits: qualify opportunities, build and execute capture plans, shape requirements with customers, and improve probability of win (pWin) through disciplined gate reviews.
  • Build and maintain the opportunity pipeline; monitor SAM.gov, DIU, AFWERX/SpaceWERX, SOCOM, SBIR/STTR, and other channels; flag and qualify new opportunities for leadership.
  • Support go/no-go reviews, conduct opportunity research, organize customer intelligence, and maintain CRM data.
  • Prepare customer briefing materials and support commercialization planning.
  • Lead teaming and partner strategy with primes, subcontractors, and non-traditional partners.
  • Develop and maintain strategic pricing and Basis of Estimate in partnership with finance; support cost and price volumes.

Project and Program Coordination

  • Assist leadership in managing internal strategic initiatives by tracking project schedules, monitoring action items, and coordinating meetings.
  • Develop executive briefings, maintain project documentation, support risk tracking, and create status reports.
  • Improve internal workflows so multiple company initiatives stay organized and moving forward.

AI-Enabled Proposal Development

  • Leverage AI tools to accelerate first drafts, improve technical writing quality, perform compliance cross-checks, build structured outlines, and edit for clarity and concision.
  • Develop internal prompt libraries and organize proposal knowledge repositories.
  • Maintain a technically credible writing style while avoiding generic AI-generated language.

Qualifications and Skills

  • 5+ years of experience in federal proposal writing, capture management, technical writing, or business development within government, defense contracting, or GovCon.
  • Exceptional writing and editing skills, with a demonstrated ability to generate large, compliant documents on short timelines.
  • Working knowledge of the U.S. Government solicitation and acquisition process (RFPs, RFIs, RFQs, white papers, SBIR/STTR, OTAs).
  • Experience owning or driving capture plans, gate and color team reviews, and win strategy (Shipley or a comparable methodology).
  • Proven ability to build process where none exists and to operate independently in a fast-paced, hyper-growth environment.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, able to extract technical content from engineers and translate it clearly for non-technical customers.
  • Strong organizational and project management ability, with comfort managing competing priorities and overlapping proposal schedules.• Familiarity with Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and Figma, and comfort using AI tools to improve writing and productivity.
  • Structured, systems-oriented thinker who is deadline-driven, coachable, and comfortable receiving heavy feedback on drafts.
  • Must be a U.S. Person (this role requires access to export-controlled data); U.S. Citizenship may be required for certain classified pursuits.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with SBIR/STTR, OTAs, DIU, AFWERX/SpaceWERX, SOCOM, or other non-traditional DoD acquisition pathways.
  • Familiarity with autonomy, robotics, UAS, aerospace, or other hardware-centric defense products.
  • Shipley Associates and/or APMP certification.
  • Experience developing pricing strategies and Basis of Estimate or cost volumes.
  • Experience with CRM or pipeline management tools.
  • Prior experience standing up a proposal or capture function at an early-stage company.
  • Active security clearance (Secret or TS/SCI).

What We Offer

Swan is a fast-paced, innovative, and collaborative startup environment. We offer a top-notch benefits package, including:

  • Top-tier health, dental, vision, short- and long-term disability, and life insurance, with full employee

coverage and partial coverage for dependents

  • Flexible and reasonable vacation and sick leave
  • 401(k) plans, FSA, HSA, and commuter benefits

Location

Remote (U.S.). Washington, DC or San Francisco strongly preferred.

Swan is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national origin, creed, religion, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, uniform service, veteran status, disability status, or any other protected characteristic per federal, state, or local law. Swan considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures, and we work to create a welcoming and supportive environment for all applicants throughout the interview process.
descriptions.job-1nk1752:
Who We Are

About Stripe

At Stripe, you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach. Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. 

About The Team

The Solutions Architecture Team partners with our users to realize their full potential through the adoption of prescriptive solutions that drive their growth and success.

We work with C-level executives, finance leaders, product design and engineering teams at large global brands and platforms who are building financial services solutions with Stripe.  We work closely with Account Executives, Professional Services, Customer Success Managers, Partners, Technical Account Managers and Product Teams to develop and execute on the account strategy for Stripe’s platform prospects. 

What You’ll Do

As a member of the team, you will build trusted relationships with C-level executives and technical decision makers in the customer’s organization to provide business and technical thought leadership, and become a trusted advisor in solving mission-critical business challenges. We architect business models with them so they can drive new monetization opportunities and growth.

Responsibilities

  • Be a key member of the Platform account team with deep involvement in defining the customer strategy; Identify and close new complex opportunities, and accelerate solution adoption. 
  • Drive thought leadership and be a trusted advisor for key business and technical stakeholders including CIO, CTO, COO, CRO, CDO, Head of Product Engineering, and Head of Payments.
  • Work to deeply understand the customer’s business objectives, and then design and apply Stripe solutions to their challenges. Develop and articulate the end to end customer transformation journey and create future roadmaps and architectures with deep third party integrations in play.
  • Conduct business analysis and background research on customers, industries, and competitors.
  • Lead strategy engagements with users to align to business priorities, design solutions and secure the technical win by performing in-depth customer discovery, evangelizing the proposed solutions through executive briefings, readouts, presentations and solution demos. 
  • Expand Stripe’s footprint within existing accounts to new global markets and business units by introducing new capabilities and local payment methods.
  • Act as the “Voice of the Customer” to bring insights, trends, and opportunities to the leadership, product, and engineering teams from the forefront and prioritized for delivery.  
  • Participate in sales forecasting, Quarterly Business Reviews, and account and territory planning to strategically and tactically align for success.
  • Act as a crucial part of the sales team, providing technical insight and solutions to prospective and existing platform users. Guide and provide technical expertise on Stripe and its benefits for both platforms and their customers.
  • Showcase the capability of Stripe's platform in solving business problems, highlighting features, benefits, and potential customizations. This includes demonstrating how those benefits pass down to the customer's own user base.
  • Manage pre-sales projects, coordinating proof-of-concept development, and feasibility checks. Ensure all solutions proposed are viable, beneficial to our potential clients, and also accommodating to their customers.

Who You Are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in a similar customer-facing engineering role such as solution consultant, solutions architect, or sales engineer, for a global software enterprise.
  • Executive engagement skills and presence, with an ability to establish strong relationships with key decision makers and build credibility at all levels.
  • Effective group-facilitation skills and confidence in proposing and leading customer meetings to gain strategic footing and pursue opportunities.
  • Thorough understanding of the software development lifecycle and API architecture.
  • Outstanding spoken and written communication skills, presentation skills, and confidence in explaining complex concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Develop a comprehensive understanding of Connect, Stripe's solution for enabling platform payments, exploring its various features, and integration methodologies.
  • Gather an in-depth understanding of Stripe's Payments and Billing systems and their applicability across diverse business models to cater to individual clients' and their customers' needs.
  • Ability to understand how a wide variety of applications such as ERP, CRM, Billing, Tax, and legacy systems interact with each other in a platform technology stack and ecosystem. 
  • Strong organizational and time management skills and the ability to juggle competing priorities while working with multiple strategic opportunities and customers.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience as a customer-facing, domain expert in the payments space, presenting, and architecting solutions for platform customers.
  • Prior experience driving technical sales with top-tier enterprise-scale platforms and supporting them and their customers' unique requirements 
  • Experience with integrating Stripe or other RESTful APIs into web applications.
  • Experience in systems design, building, and deploying complex applications.
  • Experience in helping customers adopt and consume software in a cloud model.
  • Passionate about learning and actively seek out knowledge
  • Ability to work independently and confidently to develop a path forward with customers under ambiguous circumstances.
  • Strategic and creative thinker who proactively identifies challenges and maintains a positive approach when facing difficult obstacles.
  • Strong collaboration skills to work seamlessly with extended teams to support our users.

descriptions.job-1dr9mhy:
ABOUT HUT 8

Imagine the ultimate destination for those who want to work at the cutting edge of technology, energy, and infrastructure. Hut 8 is on a mission to build and operate some of the world’s largest data centers for next-generation computing workloads, including AI, Colocation, Cloud, and Bitcoin Mining. We are proud to offer interesting and challenging opportunities for individuals who want to build teams, solve problems, and make an impact from day one. If you’re an ambitious individual looking for a career that is as rewarding as it is challenging, you’ve come to the right place.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Partner, Cyber Security is the leader accountable for defining and building Hut 8's entire security program from the ground up. Operating at the domain owner, this person owns security strategy, architecture, and governance across corporate IT, mining operations, data-center infrastructure, cloud, and AI/compute environments. They set the security vision, establish the control framework, manage the cyber security vendor (i.e. Kernel Advisory) relationship, and in-house Security Operations capability. This is a hands-on builder-leader role, reporting into the Technology organization.

What You'll Do

+  Define and own Hut 8's end-to-end cybersecurity strategy, roadmap, and security architecture spanning corporate IT, mining operations, data centers, cloud, and AI/compute environments.

+  Establish the enterprise security control framework and governance, risk & compliance (GRC) program, aligning to recognized standards (e.g., NIST CSF, ISO 27001, SOC 2) and relevant regulatory obligations.

+  Design defense-in-depth architecture across network segmentation, identity & access management (IAM), endpoint, cloud, and OT/industrial control systems, embedding "security by default" into all new systems.

+  Build and lead the Security Operations capability — threat detection, monitoring, incident response, and vulnerability management.

+  Own identity and access governance, including privileged access, MFA, SSO, least-privilege policy, and access reviews across the enterprise.

+  Lead incident response and breach management end to end: preparation, detection, containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident review, including executive and regulatory communication.

+  Manage the security vendor ecosystem and budget, defining tooling strategy, evaluating and selecting platforms, and setting clear exit criteria for reducing external dependency.

+  Establish the security awareness and anti-phishing program, driving a security-conscious culture across a rapidly scaling, multi-site workforce.

+  Partner with Software, Networking, Data Engineering, Business Intelligence and Applied AI leaders to secure the technology lifecycle, production platforms, and enterprise data without slowing delivery.

+  Recruit, mentor, and grow the internal security team, building the cyber security internal capacity.

ABOUT YOU

  • 7+ years of progressive cybersecurity/information security experience, including 3+ years in a security leadership or director role; experience at a publicly traded company (SOX environment) strongly preferred.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field; Master's or security certifications (CISSP, CISM, CCSP, GIAC) strongly preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of security architecture, cloud and SaaS security, identity & access management, network security, and endpoint/OT security; deep familiarity with SaaS-first corporate environments.
  • Hands-on experience owning security compliance frameworks and audits — SOC 2, NIST CSF / ISO 27001, SOX ITGC, and PCI — including third-party audit and assessment leadership.
  • Proven delivery of enterprise security programs — SIEM/SOC, EDR, vulnerability management, incident response, and identity & access management.
  • Experience securing platform integrations, APIs, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud/data architecture, plus disciplined testing and control-validation practices.
  • Demonstrated security budgeting and vendor/MSSP negotiation and management experience, including transitioning capabilities in-house.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder skills across technical and non-technical audiences, up to board level.

ABOUT THE WORK ENVIRONMENT

This role is in office at our corporate headquarters in the Brickell area of Miami, Florida. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

WHAT MAKES HUT 8 A GREAT PLACE TO WORK

Hut 8 offers a benefits and wellness program that includes medical, dental, vision, life, and short-term and long-term disability insurance, as well as paid time off. We are proud to invest in building the best team in the industry. At all levels of the organization, we are driven by an entrepreneurial spirit, radical transparency, and relentless growth mentality.

At Hut 8, you will have the opportunity to:

▶ Work with bright, driven peers from a range of educational and professional backgrounds including software development, energy, engineering, entrepreneurship, investment banking, private equity, and management consulting

▶ Design and pitch new products, services, and other initiatives to a leadership team consisting of serial entrepreneurs and seasoned executives and backed by a board of directors consisting of industry veterans of energy, finance, and government

▶ Debate ideas and alternatives in a truly meritocratic setting where the learning curve is steep and the lessons come from both senior and junior members of the team

▶ Build a lifelong network of friends and professional connections at the cutting-edge intersection of technology, energy, and infrastructure

Support Bybit EU's Internal Audit function as a senior audit professional responsible for planning and executing audit engagements across European operations. You will deliver high-quality audit work, drive project execution, and contribute to the continuous improvement of the audit framework under the direction of the Head of Internal Audit (EU).
This is a hands-on execution role — you will personally conduct audit fieldwork, produce deliverables, and manage individual audit projects end-to-end. The position reports to the Head of Internal Audit (EU) and works closely with external consultants, co-sourcing partners, regulators, and the Global IA team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan and execute risk-based internal audits end-to-end across finance, operations, compliance, IT, and cybersecurity — owning individual engagements from scoping through to report issuance.

  • Support the transition from outsourced audits to in-house capability — coordinate with co-sourcing partners on project delivery, review their work products for quality, and flag gaps to the Head of IA.

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • 7–10 years of experience in internal audit or related risk/control functions within financial services, fintech, or crypto.

  • Excellent written and spoken German and English for effective communication with regulators and senior stakeholders.
  • Outstanding project management skills, capable of managing multiple audits and deadlines concurrently.
  • Strong presentation and communication abilities, with experience reporting findings and recommendations to senior management.
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a global organization structure with cross-regional stakeholders.
  • Adaptable, self-driven, and comfortable in a fast-paced, evolving environment with changing priorities.
  • Knowledge of Web3 and crypto ecosystems is a strong plus

Why Join Us
At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment.  Our benefits include:
- Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
- Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
- Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.
- Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.
